findings.issue: D2 provenance marked an operator-configured source commit as verified.
findings.correction: The endpoint now returns verified=false for that marker; it does not claim independent deployment attestation.

findings.issue: The Next.js example did not apply the configured 256-byte caller-token limit during authorization.
findings.correction: Authorization rejects tokens over 256 bytes before reading the request body, matching the Express example.

decision: NO_GO: keep the production campaign paused until custody mapping and trusted source provenance are resolved.
